description:
Hi, I’m AR, an AI/ML engineer from Colombo, competing solo in the Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map challenge.

My plan is to build an interactive Mars map that helps future astronauts plan safe, science-rich Marswalks. It will combine NASA Mars mission data (CTX and HiRISE imagery, MOLA elevation) with a computer vision model that detects hazards like boulders, craters and steep slopes. A route planner then finds the safest path between points while passing interesting science stops.
